queries.title: Names or CRD numbers
queries.description: Advisors, brokers or firms to look up, one per line. A name ("jane doe") searches; an all-digits entry is treated as a CRD number and fetched directly.

searchType.title: Search
searchType.description: Look up individual advisors/brokers, or brokerage firms.

includeDetails.title: Include full record details
includeDetails.description: For individuals, also fetch each match's full BrokerCheck record: disclosures with types and dates, sanctions, exams passed, registered states and employment history. One extra request per match.

maxPerQuery.title: Matches per query
maxPerQuery.description: How many matching records to return per name searched, best matches first.

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Stop after this many rows in total.
